faq_q1: How long does the review process take?
faq_a1: Review times vary. You'll be notified when your application status changes.
faq_q2: Can I update my profile while my application is under review?
faq_a2: Profile updates are paused while your application is being reviewed.
faq_q3: Does "Under Review" mean I’ve been shortlisted?
faq_a3: Under Review means your application is being assessed. It does not confirm shortlisting.
